verdict.rationale: Algolia's official quickstart walks developers through indexing sample data and building a working search over a sample product catalog (algolia-docs-1, algolia-docs-18). The CLI supports signing up or creating an app from the terminal and managing indices (algolia-docs-63, algolia-docs-50). Independent users repeatedly describe setup as fast and easy, including importing data with a simple node script, smooth onboarding, and an easy-to-add React InstantSearch (algolia-comm-6, algolia-comm-9, algolia-comm-12, algolia-comm-16). Missing for 10: no explicit time-to-first-search measurement or 'minutes' claim, and the evidence does not detail the individual create-index and add-records steps (the quickstart is wrapped in a React app rather than a minimal API path).
